Company announcement No 65 / 2026
Company Announcement
Financial report for the period 1 January 2026 to 30 September 2026
4 November 2026
Novo raises full-year outlook on continued GLP-1 momentum, with third-quarter adjusted
operating profit increasing 27% at CER to DKK 31,720 million
Financial performance
•Q3 2026 adjusted and reported sales increased by 4% at CER, driven by continued GLP-1 volume growth across the US and
International operations, primarily in obesity.
•Q3 2026 adjusted operating profit increased by 27% at CER, driven by GLP-1 sales growth and a favourable comparison base
following DKK 9 billion of company-wide transformation costs recognised in Q3 2025.
•Q3 2026 reported operating profit decreased by 9% at CER, reflecting DKK 8.7 billion of non-cash impairment charges in the
quarter, related to ziltivekimab (DKK 4.6 billion) and right-sizing of manufacturing network (DKK 4.1 billion).
Commercial highlights
•By the end of Q3, Wegovy® pill had been launched in the US, UAE, UK and Germany, with uptake driving Q3 2026 sales of DKK 5,394
million. More recently, launches in four additional countries increased the total number of launched markets to eight.
•The Wegovy® franchise maintains its US leadership in new patient starts, with more than 50% share in the branded obesity market.
•Ozempic® pill was launched in the US in May, with encouraging early momentum. Weekly new-to-brand prescriptions (NBRx) are
currently up around 100% compared with pre-launch levels under the Rybelsus® brand.
•The global roll-out of Ozempic® 2.0 mg and the Wegovy® 7.2 mg single-dose pen across International Operations is progressing.
Pipeline progress
•Within obesity, CagriSema (1.0/1.0 mg) delivered encouraging weight loss of 21% at week 68 in the REDEFINE 9 trial.
•Also in obesity, the AMAZE 9 phase 3 trial with oral zenagamtide has been initiated in September.
•Within diabetes, CagriSema (1.0/1.0 mg) achieved superior weight loss of 12.4% compared with 9.1% for tirzepatide 5 mg, while
demonstrating non-inferior HbA1c reduction at week 60 in adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity in the REIMAGINE 5 trial.
•Within blood & endocrine disorders, Frehemgo® (denecimig) received positive CHMP opinion on 17 September and pending full EU
approval, the first launches are planned in Europe around the turn of the year. In the US, the regulatory review of denecimig is still
ongoing, and pending regulatory decision, a US launch is expected in H1 2027.
Outlook
•Adjusted sales growth for 2026 is now expected to be -2% to +2% at CER and adjusted operating profit growth is now expected to
be -2% to +2% at CER. The improved outlook is driven by increased expectations for GLP-1 product sales.
